abstract: Choriocarcinoma is one of the most serious forms of gestational trophoblastic tumor. It is a malignant tumor from the epithelium of the chorionic villi. The most frequent location site is the uterus. Associated with ectopic pregnancy, it is extremely rare and in general, very aggressive. In 75% of the cases, it items from distant metastasis; therefore, a histological examination of the tubes must be performed in all ectopic pregnancies. Our patient was a 33-year-old woman who was admitted to emergency room (ER) with an intense pain in the right, iliac cavity, and limited genital bleeding. During the exploration, there was abdominal pain, with doubtful signs of peritoneal irritation. The vaginal ultrasound offered an image that was compatible with an extra uterine pregnancy in the left appendages. At emergency, right salpingectomy was performed via laparotomy. The patient was treated with polychemotherapy and contraceptives for a year, with no recurrence of the disease. Control follow-up was performed using beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) testing on a weekly basis during the first month and then bi-monthly during the first year of follow-up.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の中で最も重篤な型の一つである。絨毛膜絨毛の上皮に由来する悪性腫瘍である。最も多い発生部位は子宮である。異所性妊娠に伴う場合は極めてまれであり、一般に非常に侵襲性が高い。症例の75%は遠隔転移を契機に発見されるため、異所性妊娠のすべての症例で卵管の病理組織学的検査を行う必要がある。症例は33歳女性で、右腸骨窩の激痛と少量の性器出血を主訴に救急外来を受診した。診察時には腹痛があり、腹膜刺激症状が疑われる所見がわずかに認められた。経腟超音波検査では、左付属器に子宮外妊娠に合致する像が認められた。救急で開腹による右卵管摘出術を施行した。患者は多剤併用化学療法と避妊を1年間受け、再発は認められなかった。フォローアップとして、最初の1か月は毎週、その後1年間は隔月でβ-hCG検査を行った。
